### Brief: parameters ( parameter list )
	# Arbitrary parameters to be checked in applying various effects.
	# Localization: "holy_site_parameter_<parameter_name>" where $PARAMETER_NAME$ inserts localized named of parameter
	# Trigger (barony scope): 'has_holy_site_parameter' where $TITLE$ inserts localized named of barony
	# Trigger (faith scope): 'controls_holy_site_with_parameter' where $FAITH$ inserts localized named of faith
	# 
	# Note: The above trigger just checks for existence, so it does not
	# matter if the value is set to 'yes' or 'no'.
	#
	parameters = {
		some_parameter = yes

### Brief: faith_character_modifier ( modifiers )
	# Modifiers applied to all characters of any faith with this holy site when the holder of the barony is of their faith.
	# Will only be applied if the holy site is an Eminent holy site for the Faith
	# Ex: { development_growth_factor = 0.1, church_holding_build_gold_cost = -0.1 }
	#
	faith_character_modifier = {
		<modifier>
	}

	### Brief: faith_character_modifier_scaled ( scalable modifier list, repeatable )
	# Optional, repeatable. Each entry defines a character modifier whose values
	# multiply by a script-evaluated scale and is applied to all characters of the faith.
	# Will only be applied if the holy site is an Eminent holy site for the Faith.
	#
	# The `scale` field is a script value evaluated with the holy_site as the top
	# scope. The built-in `holy_site_total_artifact_rarity` returns the sum of
	# Rarity values across artifacts whose is_holy_relic trigger is true.
	# (1=Common, 2=Masterwork, 3=Famed, 4=Illustrious).
	#
	faith_character_modifier_scaled = {
		scale = holy_site_total_artifact_rarity
		monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	### Brief: character_modifier ( modifiers )
	# Modifiers applied to holder of county of holy site, if same faith.
	# Will be applied if Regular or Eminent holy site of faith.
	#
	county_holder_character_modifier = {
		<modifier>
	}

	### Brief: county_modifier_scaled ( scalable modifier list, repeatable )
	# Optional, repeatable. Each entry defines a county modifier whose values
	# multiply by a script-evaluated scale and is applied to the holy site's
	# county.
	# Will be applied if Regular or Eminent holy site of faith.
	#
	# The `scale` field is a script value evaluated with the holy_site as the top
	# scope. The built-in `holy_site_total_artifact_rarity` returns the sum of
	# Rarity values across artifacts whose can_benefit_holy_site trigger
	# passes (1=Common, 2=Masterwork, 3=Famed, 4=Illustrious; 0 if none qualify).
	#
	county_modifier_scaled = {
		scale = holy_site_total_artifact_rarity
		monthly_county_control_growth_factor = 0.01
	}

parochial: "本乡本土"
 parochial_desc: "$parochial$[vassals|E]想要稳定、分权与和平，支持让领地远离外部事务。正直或内敛的封臣经常选择这种[vassal_stance|E]。

#low $parochial$封臣喜欢领主：#!
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$修建或升级[holdings|E]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$让他们成为[close_family|E]的[guardians|E]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$使用$task_domestic_affairs$[councillor_task|E]

#low $parochial$封臣不喜欢领主：#!
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$拥有高[crown_authority|E]
$EFFECT_LIST_BULLET$发动重大[wars|E]

他们更喜欢拥有高[stewardship_i][stewardship|E]能力的正直和理性的[heirs|E]。"
 parochial_filter_option: "$parochial$"
 parochial_filter_option_desc: "仅显示[GetVassalStance( 'parochial' ).GetName][vassal_stance|E]的角色"

 parochial_vassals: "[GetVassalStance( 'parochial' ).GetTextIcon][GetVassalStance( 'parochial' ).GetName][vassals|E]"
 parochial_opinion: "$parochial_vassal$好感"
 parochial_same_faith_opinion: "$parochial_opinion$#weak （相同[faith|E]）#!"
